exempt.AnnotDifftestMain: the annot-difftest executable's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve AnnotDifftest.table, audited under AnnotDifftest; a root of its own would put a second `main` beside DifftestExample's

Difftest.why: the harness is code: Lean core and C-Flock's canonical JSON, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

DifftestExample.why: the example port reaches Lean only through the harness, as a port does

AnnotDifftest.why: the annotation check's port reaches Lean through the harness and C-Flock's Flock.Annot and its per-gate reference, as a port does
